|lore=Yuzzum musician and thief. Singer for The Max Rebo Band. Stage name given to him by Sy Snootles. Jabba likes his performance, even though the Hutt despises Yuzzum.
|game_text=Power +2 on Endor or when present with your musician. When opponent draws destiny, Joh may 'jam' (place that card face down under Joh). Holds one card at a time. If Joh leaves table, place card under Joh in opponent's Used Pile.
|joke="Jam" fits him three ways.
